content.title: Playful Threat | Two Soft Interruptions Become a Partnered Exit
content.summary: In one continuous adult relationship scene, pose a controlled prop threat and let a familiar partner cross its meaning with one harmless interpersonal interruption. Escalate only once with a larger safe action, interrupt again in a distinct soft way, then redirect both characters into a voluntary shared exit.

quick_start.input_format: two clearly adult original characters, familiar relationship, and continuous path + controlled prop threat stays away from faces and bodies + partner uses one harmless interpersonal action and reaction hold + threatened adult escalates once with a safe large action before a distinct second soft interruption + both voluntarily turn into the same direction and leave together, rewriting conflict as play
quick_start.recommended_input: Two adult museum conservators walk one long gallery aisle. The cream-coated worker raises a soft dust brush; the navy partner places a catalog sticker on the sleeve. After one safe ladder spin and a distinct gentle shoulder tap, both grab the ladder and run down the aisle together.

Escalate once through a larger safe movement, then answer with a second distinct soft interruption.
End with both adults voluntarily aligned and moving together along the established path.

creative_dna.mechanism: Establish two original clearly adult characters with an already-legible familiar relationship on one continuous path. Let one adult introduce a controlled prop-based threat that stays physically separated from faces and bodies, then have the partner cross its dramatic meaning with exactly one brief non-harmful interpersonal interruption. Show the threatened adult's surprise before escalating to one larger but still safe movement; the partner responds with a second distinct soft interruption rather than force. Preserve costume, prop, path direction and personal boundaries throughout. End when both adults voluntarily align to the same travel direction and leave together, reframing conflict as bonded play. The reusable mechanism is controlled threat, soft semantic interruption, reaction, safe escalation, repeated relational override and partnered exit—not the source woman, man, faces, robes, sword, bamboo forest, finger tap, sleeves, kicks, exact gestures, creator identity or timing.

invariants.rule: Introduce one controlled prop threat with clear physical separation from bodies and faces.
invariants.purpose: Creates dramatic tension without depicting actual harm.
invariants.ablation_failure: Contact with the weapon changes the scene into violence.

invariants.rule: Use one brief non-harmful interpersonal interruption and hold the threatened adult's reaction.
invariants.purpose: Lets relationship meaning override action meaning.
invariants.ablation_failure: Skipping the reaction makes the touch decorative.

invariants.rule: Escalate once through a larger safe movement, then answer with a second distinct soft interruption.
invariants.purpose: Creates a comic two-turn pattern rather than random flirting.
invariants.ablation_failure: Repeated identical beats feel mechanical; real force breaks the tone.

invariants.rule: End with both adults voluntarily aligned and moving together along the established path.
invariants.purpose: Reframes conflict as bonded play through action.
invariants.ablation_failure: One character fleeing alone would imply unresolved threat.
